svg.desc: Full figure inventory: left input image patches above graph node clusters feed an encoder; arrows enter a main upper pipeline frame containing a vision graph structure, semantic low-rank prompt module, prompted graph features, repeated Vision GNN block, downstream head, and loss. Bottom row contains a legend and three explanatory frames for SeLo-Graph, SeLo-Edge, and SeLo-Node prompts. Layout follows the original left-to-right pipeline and top-to-bottom detailed prompt panels.

g.desc: Image patch mosaic: square patches clipped from a cat-like photograph, arranged above the graph node view.

Upper main pipeline: vision graph structure at left, low-rank decomposition prompt box in center, prompted graph feature frame, repeated GNN layers, then downstream head and loss. Symmetry basis is horizontal left-to-right processing with paired top/bottom prompt outputs.
Legend frame: add and product symbols, frozen and trainable icons, and swatches for virtual node feature, low-rank semantic feature, three prompt types, and composed prompts.
